title: پروژه نهایی — فاز ۱: راه‌اندازی
lead: راه‌اندازی پروژه با ساختار حرفه‌ای، تنظیمات چندمحیطی، Docker، Celery و ابزارهای پایه. این فاز پایه‌ای است که همه فازهای بعدی روی آن بنا می‌شوند.

blocks.text: اول محیط مجازی، نصب پکیج‌ها و ساختار پروژه.

blocks.code:
# ساخت پوشه
mkdir library_system && cd library_system

# محیط مجازی
python -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate   # لینوکس/مک
# .venv\Scripts\activate    # ویندوز

# نصب پکیج‌های اصلی
pip install --upgrade pip
pip install \
    "Django>=5.0,<5.1" \
    "djangorestframework>=3.15" \
    "djangorestframework-simplejwt>=5.3" \
    "django-filter>=24.0" \
    "drf-spectacular>=0.27" \
    "django-cors-headers>=4.3" \
    "psycopg2-binary>=2.9" \
    "redis>=5.0" \
    "celery>=5.3" \
    "django-celery-beat>=2.5" \
    "django-prometheus>=2.3" \
    "python-json-logger>=2.0" \
    "sentry-sdk>=1.40" \
    "python-dotenv>=1.0" \
    "Pillow>=10.0" \
    "python-magic>=0.4" \
    "djangorestframework-simplejwt[crypto]"

# پکیج‌های تست
pip install \
    "pytest>=8.0" \
    "pytest-django>=4.8" \
    "pytest-cov>=4.1" \
    "factory_boy>=3.3" \
    "Faker>=22.0" \
    "ruff>=0.3" \
    "black>=24.0" \
    "django-debug-toolbar>=4.3" \
    "django-silk>=5.0"

# پروژه Django
django-admin startproject library_system .

# اپلیکیشن‌ها
python manage.py startapp common
python manage.py startapp users
python manage.py startapp catalog
python manage.py startapp reviews
python manage.py startapp favorites
python manage.py startapp loans
python manage.py startapp payments
python manage.py startapp notifications
python manage.py startapp reports

# git
git init
git add .
git commit -m "chore: initial project structure"

import logging
from contextvars import ContextVar

_request_id: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("request_id", default="-")
_user_id: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("user_id", default="-")
_path: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("path", default="-")
_method: ContextVar[str] = ContextVar("method", default="-")


def set_request_context(request_id, user_id="-", path="-", method="-"):
    _request_id.set(request_id)
    _user_id.set(str(user_id))
    _path.set(path)
    _method.set(method)


def clear_request_context():
    _request_id.set("-")
    _user_id.set("-")
    _path.set("-")
    _method.set("-")


class RequestContextFilter(logging.Filter):
    def filter(self, record):
        record.request_id = _request_id.get()
        record.user_id = _user_id.get()
        record.path = _path.get()
        record.method = _method.get()
        return True

import logging
import uuid
from django.core.exceptions import ValidationError as DjangoValidationError
from django.http import Http404
from rest_framework.exceptions import APIException, ValidationError
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework.views import exception_handler

logger = logging.getLogger("api.errors")


class DomainError(APIException):
    status_code = 400
    default_code = "domain_error"


class BusinessRuleViolation(DomainError):
    default_code = "business_rule_violation"
    default_detail = "قاعده کسب‌وکار نقض شد."


class ResourceConflict(DomainError):
    status_code = 409
    default_code = "conflict"
    default_detail = "تناقض در داده."


def custom_exception_handler(exc, context):
    if isinstance(exc, DjangoValidationError):
        exc = ValidationError(detail=exc.messages)
    if isinstance(exc, Http404):
        from rest_framework.exceptions import NotFound
        exc = NotFound()

    response = exception_handler(exc, context)
    request = context.get("request")

    if response is None:
        incident_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
        logger.exception(f"Unhandled error [{incident_id}]")
        return Response({
            "success": False,
            "error": {"code": "INTERNAL_ERROR", "message": "خطای غیرمنتظره."},
            "incident_id": incident_id,
        }, status=500)

    code = getattr(exc, "default_code", "error")
    if isinstance(response.data, dict) and "detail" in response.data:
        message = str(response.data["detail"])
        details = None
    else:
        message = "خطا در پردازش درخواست."
        details = response.data

    response.data = {
        "success": False,
        "error": {"code": code.upper(), "message": message, "details": details},
    }
    return response

[project]
name = "library-system"
version = "1.0.0"
requires-python = ">=3.11"

[tool.ruff]
line-length = 100
target-version = "py311"
exclude = [".git", ".venv", "migrations", "staticfiles", "media"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "W", "F", "I", "B", "C4", "DJ", "S", "T20", "SIM", "UP"]
ignore = ["E501", "S101", "DJ001"]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"*/migrations/*" = ["E", "W", "F", "DJ"]
"*/tests/*" = ["S101", "S105", "S106"]
"*/settings/*" = ["F403", "F405"]

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["library_system", "common", "users", "catalog", "reviews", "favorites", "loans", "payments", "notifications", "reports"]

[tool.black]
line-length = 100
target-version = ["py311"]

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE = "library_system.settings.dev"
python_files = ["test_*.py", "*_test.py"]
addopts = [
    "--reuse-db",
    "--strict-markers",
    "--cov=.",
    "--cov-report=term-missing",
    "--cov-report=html",
    "--cov-fail-under=75",
    "-ra",
    "-q",
]
markers = [
    "slow: tests that take too long",
    "integration: integration tests",
]

[tool.coverage.run]
source = ["."]
omit = [
    "*/migrations/*",
    "*/tests/*",
    "*/admin.py",
    "manage.py",
    "*/settings/*",
    "*/asgi.py",
    "*/wsgi.py",
]

exercises.title: تمرین — راه‌اندازی پروژه
exercises.problem: پروژه را راه‌اندازی کنید: محیط مجازی، نصب پکیج‌ها، ساختار پوشه‌ها، settings سه‌گانه، `common/` با همه فایل‌های پایه (models، exceptions، middleware، logging، pagination، permissions، routers، metrics، views). سپس یک کاربر superuser بسازید و `/health/`، `/live/` و `/api/docs/` را تست کنید.
hints: از `requirements.txt` بخش این فصل استفاده کنید.
همه فایل‌های `common/` را از این فصل کپی کنید.
exercises.solution:
همه کدها در این فصل آمده است. مراحل:
1. `mkdir library_system && cd library_system`
2. `python -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate`
3. `pip install -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt`
4. `django-admin startproject library_system .`
5. ساخت اپلیکیشن‌ها با `startapp`
6. کپی فایل‌های `common/` از این فصل
7. کپی `settings/` سه‌گانه
8. کپی `celery.py` و `urls.py`
9. `createdb library_db && python manage.py migrate`
10. `python manage.py createsuperuser`
11. `python manage.py runserver`
12. تست: `curl http://127.0.0.1:8000/health/`

نتیجه: یک اسکلت کامل آماده برای فاز مدل‌ها.
